arrowaligntriggerbot.name: Arrow Align Triggerbot
arrowaligntriggerbot.desc: Turns the arrows of the F7/M7 arrow align device into place while your crosshair is on them.

lightsdevicetriggerbot.name: Lights Device Triggerbot
lightsdevicetriggerbot.desc: Flips the six lights device levers of F7/M7 phase 3 when your crosshair is on one.

norotatebuttontest.name: No Rotate Button Test
norotatebuttontest.desc: Alternates silent clicks on the two stone buttons at (-2, 85, -93) and (-2, 85, -90).

auto_join_confirm.name: Auto Join Confirm
auto_join_confirm.desc: Confirms the Undersized party menu when you queue again while solo in a dungeon.

silent_menus.name: Silent Menus
silent_menus.desc: Open the menus without showing them on screen.

click_delay.name: Click Delay
click_delay.desc: Wait a random time before clicking instead of clicking at once.

min_click_delay.name: Min Click Delay
min_click_delay.desc: Shortest wait before each menu click.

max_click_delay.name: Max Click Delay
max_click_delay.desc: Longest wait before each menu click.

autobm.name: Auto BM
autobm.desc: Automatically upgrades Ballista Mechanic in Kuudra.

min_first_click_delay.name: Min First Click Delay
min_first_click_delay.desc: Shortest wait before the first upgrade click.

max_first_click_delay.name: Max First Click Delay
max_first_click_delay.desc: Longest wait before the first upgrade click.

autoclicker.name: Auto Clicker
autoclicker.desc: Automatically clicks left/right mouse buttons with customizable speeds and filters.

hold_keybind.name: Hold Keybind
hold_keybind.desc: Active only while the hotkey is held down. If disabled, the hotkey toggles on/off.

hold_click.name: Hold Click
hold_click.desc: Hold down the click button continuously instead of rapid tapping.

ground_only.name: Ground Only
ground_only.desc: Only click while the player is on the ground.

autotnt.name: Auto TNT
autotnt.desc: Blows up cracked Catacombs walls with Superboom TNT while you look at them.

button.name: Button
button.desc: Which click blows the wall. Both work; right click is the one the item's own ability is written for.

use_delay.name: Use Delay
use_delay.desc: Wait between taking the TNT and clicking. Nothing needs it to work - it is here so the swap and the click are not the same instant every time.
use_delay.unsafe: Clicking in the same tick you swapped is a gap no hand produces.

delay_jitter.name: Delay Jitter
delay_jitter.desc: Up to this many extra ticks are added to each wait, drawn fresh every time.
delay_jitter.unsafe: With no jitter every boom sits the identical number of ticks after the swap, wall after wall.

reach.name: Reach
reach.desc: How close the wall has to be before it fires. Measured from where you stand to the block's own outline, not to the middle of the space it sits in.

retries.name: Retries
retries.desc: Extra clicks if the wall is still standing afterwards. A wall that broke stops being a target, so these cost nothing in the normal case.

swap_back.name: Swap Back
swap_back.desc: Put the slot you were holding back once the wall is dealt with. Off leaves you on the TNT.

swap_back_delay.name: Swap Back Delay
swap_back_delay.desc: How long to keep the TNT out after clicking. One tick is the mechanical floor; more of them is what a hand looks like.

autofireveil.name: Auto Fire Veil
autofireveil.desc: Casts Fire Veil every few seconds while you have the wand in your hotbar and the mana for it.

interval.name: Interval
interval.desc: Time between casts. Fire Veil lasts 5 seconds and has a 5 second cooldown; a dungeon Mage casts it sooner.

swap_back.name: Swap Back
swap_back.desc: Put the slot you were holding back after the cast. Off leaves you on the wand.

rotations.name: Rotations
rotations.desc: Skill presets for the Blackum Algorithm and the simulated hand behind its turns.

presets.name: Presets
presets.desc: Built-in skill levels and your own. AutoSS, Actions and Secret Utils pick one in their Rotation Curve.
presets.label: Edit

norotate_cam.name: NoRotate Cam
norotate_cam.desc: While a silent rotation is active, show what the server sees in the top-left corner. Hidden while a shader pack is in use.

norotate_cam_fps.name: NoRotate Cam FPS
norotate_cam_fps.desc: How often the view is redrawn. Every redraw renders the world once more.

autoclosechest.name: Auto Close Chest
autoclosechest.desc: Keeps dungeon secret chests from opening their window.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc:
Sneak: sneak as you click a chest, so it counts without opening.
Close On Open: close the chest window the moment the server opens it.

min_sneak_ticks.name: Min Sneak Ticks
min_sneak_ticks.desc: Shortest time sneak stays held after the click.

max_sneak_ticks.name: Max Sneak Ticks
max_sneak_ticks.desc: Longest time sneak stays held after the click. Each click picks a random length between the two.

secrethitboxes.name: Secret Utils
secrethitboxes.desc: Enlarges the hitboxes of buttons, levers, secret skulls and mushrooms, and can click secrets for you.

levers.name: Levers
levers.desc: Enlarge lever hitboxes. The Floor 7 lights device levers keep theirs.

lever_size.name: Lever Size
lever_size.desc: Side of the lever hitbox, in blocks.

button_size.name: Button Size
button_size.desc: Side of the button hitbox, in blocks.

secret_skulls.name: Secret Skulls
secret_skulls.desc: Give wither essence and redstone key skulls a full-block hitbox.

click_real_hitbox.name: Click Real Hitbox
click_real_hitbox.desc: When a click lands only on the enlarged part, cancel it, turn onto the real hitbox and click that instead. A real hitbox that cannot be hit is not clicked at all.

snap.name: Snap
snap.desc: Jump onto the real hitbox and click within a tick instead of turning.

aim_preset.name: Aim Preset
aim_preset.desc: The skill level the Blackum Curve aims at. Edit presets in Settings > Rotations.

correction_speed.name: Correction Speed
correction_speed.desc: How fast the aim turns onto the real hitbox, and back again with No Rotate.

no_rotate.name: No Rotate
no_rotate.desc: Turn only the aim the server sees; your camera stays put.

click_on_contact.name: Click On Contact
click_on_contact.desc: Click as soon as the crosshair reaches the real hitbox; the turn still finishes after the click.

contact_delay.name: Contact Delay
contact_delay.desc: Wait a random number of ticks on the real hitbox, up to this many, before an on-contact click.

aim_spread.name: Aim Spread
aim_spread.desc: How much of the real hitbox the corrected aim may land on, as a share of its width, height and depth. The aim point is picked at random inside that share.
aim_spread.unsafe: Below 20% every corrected aim lands on nearly the same pixel of the hitbox.

triggerbot.name: Triggerbot
triggerbot.desc: In dungeon rooms, click chests, wither essence and redstone key skulls, and the room's secret levers once each when your crosshair lands on them, and stop breaking them while attack is held so the clicks go through. Uses Click Real Hitbox when that is on.

trigger_delay.name: Trigger Delay
trigger_delay.desc: Wait a random number of ticks on a secret, up to this many, before the triggerbot clicks it.

cheater_map.name: Cheater Map
cheater_map.desc: Show all rooms on the map, including undiscovered ones.

mode_keybind.name: Mode Keybind
mode_keybind.desc: Keybind to switch between cheat and legit map mode.

keybind_mode.name: Keybind Mode
keybind_mode.desc: Toggle switches mode on press; Hold temporarily switches mode while held down.

highlight_mimic.name: Highlight Mimic
highlight_mimic.desc: Highlight the mimic room on the map.

instant_room_update.name: Instant Room Update
instant_room_update.desc: Update entered rooms and their neighbors without waiting for the hotbar map.

instant_room_update_scope.name: Instant Room Update Scope
instant_room_update_scope.desc: Choose which runs use instant room updates.

mimic_color.name: Mimic Color
mimic_color.desc: Color for the mimic room highlight.

mimic_esp.name: Mimic ESP
mimic_esp.desc: Highlight the mimic chest in the world.

mimic_esp_mode.name: Mimic ESP Mode
mimic_esp_mode.desc: How to render the mimic chest ESP.

mimic_esp_color.name: Mimic ESP Color
mimic_esp_color.desc: Color for the mimic chest ESP.

clear_water_vision.name: Clear Water Vision
clear_water_vision.desc: Removes the fog and the screen overlay while your head is underwater.

clear_lava_vision.name: Clear Lava Vision
clear_lava_vision.desc: Removes the thick fog while your head is in lava.

clear_effect_vision.name: Clear Effect Vision
clear_effect_vision.desc: Removes the fog from Blindness and Darkness, and the Darkness pulse.

clear_block_vision.name: Clear Block Vision
clear_block_vision.desc: Removes the block texture covering your screen while your head is inside a block.

leap_rotate.name: Leap Rotate
leap_rotate.desc: After a leap, look where the teammate was looking when you clicked their head. Skipped when they were out of render distance.

snap.name: Snap
snap.desc: Jump to their view instantly instead of turning.

aim_preset.name: Aim Preset
aim_preset.desc: The skill level the Blackum Curve aims at. Edit presets in Settings > Rotations.

turn_speed.name: Turn Speed
turn_speed.desc: How fast the aim turns to their view, and back again with No Rotate.

no_rotate.name: No Rotate
no_rotate.desc: Turn only the aim the server sees; your camera stays put until you move it.

fast_leap.name: Fast Leap
fast_leap.desc: Left-click a Spirit Leap or Infinileap to leap straight to the teammate set below. Opens the menu when nobody is set.

click_delay.name: Click Delay
click_delay.desc: How long to wait after the leap menu opens before clicking the teammate's head.

door_opener.name: Door Opener
door_opener.desc: During clear, leap to whoever opened the last Wither door.

s1_leap.name: S1 Leap
s1_leap.desc: From P2 into section 1: leap to this class, a player by name, or whoever is at SS (Location).

s2_leap.name: S2 Leap
s2_leap.desc: From section 1 into section 2: leap to this class, a player by name, or whoever is at EE2 (Location).

s3_leap.name: S3 Leap
s3_leap.desc: From section 2 into section 3: leap to this class, a player by name, or whoever is at EE3 (Location).

s4_leap.name: S4 Leap
s4_leap.desc: From section 3 into section 4: leap to this class, a player by name, or whoever is at Core (Location).

highlight_all_doors.name: Highlight All Doors
highlight_all_doors.desc: Highlight every unopened door instead of only the next ones.

replace_doors.name: Replace Doors
replace_doors.desc: Draw wither and blood doors as glass, or hide them as barriers. Only changes how they look.

fixed_norotate_movement.name: Fixed NoRotate Movement
fixed_norotate_movement.desc: While NoRotate turns you, your movement keys keep moving you where the camera faces.

invwalk.name: InvWalk
invwalk.desc: Walk with your inventory open. You stop for item clicks and walk again once your cursor is empty.

resume_delay.name: Resume Delay
resume_delay.desc: How long your cursor has to stay empty before you walk again. 0 walks again right away.

freecam.name: Freecam
freecam.desc: Allows you to fly out of your body to inspect the world.

hold_mode.name: Hold Mode
hold_mode.desc: Active only while the hotkey is held down.

show_hands.name: Show Hands
show_hands.desc: Whether to render player hands while in Freecam.

perspective.name: Perspective
perspective.desc: Allows looking around in a 360 degree third-person view without changing your heading.

hold_mode.name: Hold Mode
hold_mode.desc: Active only while the hotkey is held down.

scroll_zoom.name: Scroll Zoom
scroll_zoom.desc: Allows zooming with the mouse scroll wheel.

autorelic.name: Auto Relic
autorelic.desc: Grabs relics in M7 phase 5, then walks the red and orange ones to their cauldrons and places them.

rotation.name: Rotation
rotation.desc: Smooth turns in a set time, like a practiced flick. Snap faces the target within the same tick.
rotation.unsafe: No hand turns a hundred degrees between two ticks.

aim_preset.name: Aim Preset
aim_preset.desc: The skill level the Blackum Curve aims at. Edit presets in Settings > Rotations.

rotation_jitter.name: Rotation Jitter
rotation_jitter.desc: Random offset added to each smooth aim point, so repeated grabs and places do not land on the exact same spot.

no_rotate.name: No Rotate
no_rotate.desc: Turn only the direction the server sees; your camera stays put. Walking follows that hidden direction.

auto_walk.name: Auto Walk
auto_walk.desc: Walk a red or orange relic to its cauldron. Pressing W, A, S, D, Space or Shift cancels everything.

grab_aura.name: Grab Aura
grab_aura.desc: Pick up any relic within entity reach.

place_aura.name: Place Aura
place_aura.desc: Place a red or orange relic as soon as its cauldron is within block reach.

early_trigger.name: Early Trigger
early_trigger.desc: Start the moment a relic is clicked rather than when it lands in your hotbar. Gives up if it has not arrived 5 ticks later.

leap_to_carrier.name: Leap To Carrier
leap_to_carrier.desc: Once green, blue or purple is in your hotbar, leap to whoever took red (for green) or orange (for blue and purple). Falls back to the Archer or Berserk while nobody has.

automask.name: Auto Mask
automask.desc: Swaps to your next invincibility item after one saves you.

spirit_mask.name: Spirit Mask
spirit_mask.desc: Equip the Spirit Mask after a proc.

bonzo_s_mask.name: Bonzo's Mask
bonzo_s_mask.desc: Equip Bonzo's Mask after a proc.

phoenix_pet.name: Phoenix Pet
phoenix_pet.desc: Swap to the Phoenix pet after a proc.

priority.name: Priority
priority.desc: Drag the items into the order to swap to them; the first ready one wins.

swap_delay.name: Swap Delay
swap_delay.desc: Server ticks to wait after a proc before swapping.

phoenix_swap.name: Phoenix Swap
phoenix_swap.desc: Rod Swap casts a hotbar fishing rod for an Autopet rule; Pet Menu summons Phoenix from the pets menu.

boss_only.name: Boss Only
boss_only.desc: Only swap in the boss room.

silent_menus.name: Silent Menus
silent_menus.desc: Open the menus without showing them on screen.

stop_movement.name: Stop Movement
stop_movement.desc: Stand still while a hidden menu is open, as you would with it on screen.

cancel_on_input.name: Cancel On Input
cancel_on_input.desc: Stop the menu task when you press a key or mouse button while a hidden menu is open.

min_click_delay.name: Min Click Delay
min_click_delay.desc: Shortest wait before each menu click.

max_click_delay.name: Max Click Delay
max_click_delay.desc: Longest wait before each menu click.

show_progress.name: Show Progress
show_progress.desc: Show the running menu task in a HUD element you can move in the HUD editor.

auto_solve.name: Auto Solve
auto_solve.desc: Rotate to and click the buttons for you. Everything below it is inert while this is off.

no_rotate.name: No Rotate
no_rotate.desc: Aim using server-side rotation while your camera stays put.

override_key.name: Override Key
override_key.desc: Cuts the solver dead and switches it off, for when it starts doing something stupid. Press it again to turn the same mode back on.

reset_state.name: Reset State
reset_state.desc: Forget the aim, any owed start clicks and the fact that this round was already started, so it can arm and try again without being switched off and on.
reset_state.label: Reset

auto_start.name: Auto Start
auto_start.desc: Click the start button automatically once Goldor speaks.

start_no_rotate.name: No Rotate
start_no_rotate.desc: Aim using server-side rotation while your camera stays put.

start_clicks.name: Start Clicks
start_clicks.desc: How many times to click the start button.

restart_on_break.name: Restart On Break
restart_on_break.desc: Press start again when the device breaks. A failed skip is NOT a break: restarting for one costs more time than simply solving the round out.

swap_to_leap.name: Swap To Leap
swap_to_leap.desc: Once you finish the device, swap to your Spirit Leap or Infinileap.

swap_mode.name: Swap Mode
swap_mode.desc:
Swap: hold the leap.
Swap and Open: also right-click it to open the leap menu.

activation_radius.name: Activation Radius
activation_radius.desc: How close to the device you must stand before it does anything. Goldor's line and the device's hologram reach the whole room, so without this it turns your view while someone else is doing the device.

auto_mode.name: Auto Mode
auto_mode.desc:
PreAim: hold the aim on the button to press next.
Path: follow the pattern as it plays, then press.

auto_delay.name: Auto Delay
auto_delay.unsafe: Under 3 ticks the clicks land closer together than a human can press.

aim_preset.name: Aim Preset
aim_preset.desc: The skill level the Blackum Curve aims at. Edit presets in Settings > Rotations.

aim_spread.name: Aim Spread
aim_spread.desc: How much of the button each aim may land on, as a share of its real width, height and depth. The aim point is picked at random inside that share.
aim_spread.unsafe: Below 20% every aim lands on nearly the same pixel of the button, round after round.

settle_aim_before_clicks.name: Settle Aim Before Clicks
settle_aim_before_clicks.desc: Grim DuplicateRotPlace bypass. Before a click that follows a big turn, turn the aim a tiny random amount that stays on the target, and keep the aim still through the click. Not necessary: repeating the exact same turn is unlikely.

rotation_jitter.name: Rotation Jitter
rotation_jitter.desc: Random offset added to the point a ROTATE step aims at, so repeated runs do not land on the exact same spot. Has no effect on Insta Snap steps or steps that aim by angle.

aim_preset.name: Aim Preset
aim_preset.desc: The skill level the Blackum Curve aims at. Edit presets in Settings > Rotations.

disable_silent_align.name: Disable Silent Align
disable_silent_align.desc: Turn off silent alignment during ActionStep ALIGN execution, restoring visual camera snapping and movement input locks.

align_debugger.name: Align Debugger
align_debugger.desc: Enable the 3D visual debugger for alignment (rendering target offset and predicted trajectories in the world).

align_timeout.name: Align Timeout
align_timeout.desc: Default timeout in seconds for ALIGN action step when not specified by the step.

secret_hitboxes.blocked: Something got in the way of the click

simon_says_cheats.overridden: Auto Simon Says: overridden, now off.
simon_says_cheats.no_leap: Auto Simon Says: no Spirit Leap or Infinileap in your hotbar.

auto_relic.cancelled: Auto Relic: cancelled by your input.
auto_relic.no_relic: Auto Relic: the relic never arrived, stopped.
auto_relic.leap_no_target: Auto Relic: found nobody to leap to.
auto_relic.leap_none: Auto Relic: no Spirit Leap in your hotbar.
auto_relic.leap_no_menu: Auto Relic: the leap menu did not open.
auto_relic.leap_not_in_menu: Auto Relic: %s is not in the leap menu.

leap_menu_cheats.no_leap: Fast Leap: no Spirit Leap or Infinileap in your hotbar.
leap_menu_cheats.no_menu: Fast Leap: the leap menu did not open.
leap_menu_cheats.not_in_menu: Fast Leap: %s is not in the leap menu.
leap_menu_cheats.nobody: Fast Leap: can't find anyone to leap to.

rotation_presets.title: Presets
rotation_presets.note_built_in: Built in and read-only. Duplicate it to make your own.

auto_mask.none_left: Auto Mask: no invincibility left, back to your previous pet.
auto_mask.phoenix_timeout: Auto Mask: Phoenix did not proc within 5s, back to your previous pet.
auto_mask.no_rod: Auto Mask: no fishing rod in your hotbar.
auto_mask.rod_failed: Auto Mask: the rod cast did not go through.
